A track, an artist, an album or a line from a song — it\'ll turn up

When a song has several artists joined by «&», a comma, «feat.» and the like, it turns up under each of them. Bands that simply have such signs in their names («Earth, Wind & Fire», «AC/DC») are recognised and kept in one piece. If a band still gets split, it can go here.
